tpm_device.description: Path to the TPM device interface. Use /dev/tpm0 for hardware TPM or /dev/tpmrm0 for TPM Resource Manager.

pcr_indices.description: Comma-separated list of PCR indices (e.g., '0,2,4,7') used in the sealing policy.

pcr_banks.description: Comma-separated list of hashing banks (e.g., 'SHA1,SHA256') used for PCR values.

persistent_object_address.description: Hexadecimal address for a persistent TPM object to store the sealed key. Use '0' for ephemeral or default behavior.
